Answer the customer's question using only the documentation passages provided in the message. Each passage starts with an ID in square brackets, such as [pricing-1].

- If the passages answer the question, give a short, direct answer and list the IDs of the passages you used in "citations".
- If the passages do not contain the answer, set "declined" to true, say briefly that the documentation doesn't cover it, and leave "citations" empty. Do not guess, and do not use outside knowledge about other companies.

Documentation passages:

[api-5] API versions
Version 2 is the current API version. Version 1 is deprecated and will be shut down on 2027-03-31. Clients choose the version by sending the Brightwell-Version header, for example "Brightwell-Version: 2".

[pricing-1] Plans and seats
Brightwell Cloud has three plans, billed per workspace. Starter costs $19 per month and allows up to 3 users. Team costs $49 per month and includes 10 users; each additional user on Team costs $6 per user per month. Business costs $199 per month and includes 25 users, single sign-on (SSO) and the audit log.

[sla-5] Support response times
For priority-1 incidents, Business customers get a first response within 1 hour, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Team customers get a first response to priority-1 incidents within 8 business hours. Starter customers get email support with a first response within 2 business days.

[api-1] Rate limits
API rate limits apply per workspace: 60 requests per minute on Starter, 600 requests per minute on Team and 3,000 requests per minute on Business.

Customer question: Is Brightwell Cloud SOC 2 certified?

data.answer: Our documentation doesn't say whether Brightwell Cloud is SOC 2 certified. It covers plans and pricing, support response times, API versions and rate limits, but not security certifications. Please contact Brightwell Cloud support or sales to confirm.
